statement_summary: Security and privacy lead designated in writing
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted
Sanctions; good-faith reporting protected
No security terms, no access: vendor security addendum with 24-hour incident notice
Annual independent assessment
Security records kept at least 5 years
Annual policy review; policies available to staff
Approval before new devices, software, or platform features (including AI) are used
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions, including patch and antivirus exclusions
Monthly patching (critical within 14 days), malware protection, supported firmware; BAS patches approved by the contractor
Unique accounts in every system; no shared BAS or contractor accounts
Least privilege; time-limited integrator administrator access; separate administrator accounts
App-based MFA for all administrators, the remote access service, the backup console, and the MSP platform
Staff departure checklist completed by the last day
Building credentials on written request; quarterly tenant confirmation; 90-day inactivity disable
Monthly account review; Managing Member reviews administrator changes
Sealed break-glass credentials
Contractor remote access only through the approved service with MFA, per-session approval, and recording
Password manager; 16-character passwords; defaults changed before connecting
BAS workstation only for the BAS; USB blocked except a scanned company drive
Building devices on their own segment at each property; nothing reachable from the internet
Look only at the information the job needs
No company information in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at hire and yearly; phishing simulations; OT module
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed policy acknowledgment
Ransomware-on-BAS runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including OT anomalies
Log every incident
Safety first: manual operation; never switch off life-safety systems
Record the Florida determination date; documented no-notice decisions
Meet the notice deadlines in the P08 matrix; counsel reviews notices
Insurer hotline first; MSP and controls contractor engaged
Ransom payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Voluntary report to CISA or the FBI
Vendor incident reports logged and handled
Card data compromise or terminal tampering: stop, preserve, notify processor and acquirer
Annual tabletop with the MSP and controls contractor
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels, including building system data and video
Encrypt Restricted data; no applications by plain email
Restricted data only in approved locations; leasing folder restricted and not synced
One inventory of IT and OT devices and data locations
New vendors and features approved and under the security addendum
Approved AI and analytics features only; face match not approved
Immutable 90-day backups with MFA; controller program copies; quarterly restore tests
Retention schedule; shredding, deletion, and wiping with records
Card data only on the P2PE terminal; weekly inspections; tampering training
Controlled release of video and access history
